requirement.fact: The production drift monitoring has no governance.
requirement.reading: There is no sign-off process for the drift monitoring results today.

narrator.name: Reliability Ruth
narrator.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.content: I checked the logs for the drift alerts that fired last Tuesday. The system flagged a significant drop in forecast accuracy for the northern stores, but the alert just sat in the queue. No one reviewed the output. There is no formal process for approving or rejecting these drift signals. The monitoring service runs, but the results go nowhere. I looked for a ticket or a sign off from the team, but there was nothing. The alert was generated, and then it was ignored. The pipeline is active, but the governance layer around it is empty.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a descriptive report of the current system state and past events, containing no explicit wishes, refusals, or stated needs from the author.
